name: The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn was written by Mark Twain, first published in 1884.
Huck and the escaped enslaved man Jim raft down the Mississippi -- written in vernacular dialect and widely regarded as a foundational American novel.
Discussion prompt: Freedom is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
